title: All filter and view settings are remembered per browser and restored before the first data fetch on the next visit
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the report in a browser you can revisit.
custom_steps:
1. Set a custom date range, "Parts only," "Paid," a specific location set, Show Unassigned on, hide two metric columns, and sort by Margin descending.
2. Leave the report and return; also try a full page reload.
3. Watch what data loads first.
custom_expected:
1. Every setting is restored: date range (including the custom start/end), product type, invoice status, location, Show Unassigned, column visibility, and the active column sort (column + direction).
2. The settings are restored BEFORE the first data fetch — the report does not fetch defaults first and then re-fetch.
